title: Bot Honesty Scorecard
one_liner: Builds a test script for your AI agent and scores a pasted transcript on disclosure, memory and pressure tactics.
headline: Pick your business and channel, get a real probe script, then paste your AI agent's actual transcript to see it scored and flagged line-by-line for disclosure, memory, hand-off and sales-pressure honesty.

episode.title: Thanksgiving Special: The Moments That Almost Ended Us (And Why We’re Grateful) | EP #315

history.summary:
This is a genuinely working tool, not a mockup: the probe-script generator and the regex-based transcript scorer both do real work against whatever text the owner pastes, with quoted evidence lines per flag, and it's honest about being a rule-based heuristic rather than a certification. Code is clean, self-contained, and well-labeled; the only real gaps are heuristic brittleness (strict phrase matching can miss paraphrased good behaviour) and some minor polish items, none of which block publishing.</parameter>
